selection_method: Python random.Random(seed), one draw per independently authored option list; no candidate data consulted
request_origin: Actual requester delegates selection and reference generation; detailed garment and scene requirements are agent-authored frozen test design.

required_pixel_gates.criterion: Two separate top/bottom garments and visible midriff gap
Separate triangular cups visibly gathered onto thin underbust string
Paired strings extend upward from cup tips toward neck; neck-tie topology must be visually supported, ambiguity fails
Both hips show two thin string ends tied into a bow
Opaque fine ribs and bound cup edges discernible
Face visibly retains reference facial proportions, brown eyes and long dark waves; this is perceptual resemblance, not identity verification
Raised right palm visibly intersects copper-spout stream and causes droplets
Window structure, wet terracotta, rain/stream and light produce readable interaction
Face, garment, palm contact and feet visible in single full-body photograph

decision_rule: Every required gate must PASS; PARTIAL, FAIL or UNASSESSABLE makes overall not-pass. Preflight success and candidate exposure/adoption are separate from pixels.
data_effect_rule: Report exposure and adoption only if evidenced by exact pack candidate IDs and literal composed evidence; baseline already specifies garment so successful pixels alone cannot establish causal dataset improvement.
